name: Rockford (United States)
description: White field bearing the city logo: THE CITY OF ROCKFORD ILLINOIS, USA in grey with olive green hills and blue river lines.
history: Rockford is the county seat of Winnebago County, Illinois. The file shows the city's logo flag; Flags of the World records that the previous flag was designed in 1952 by Dora H. Bloom for the centennial of incorporation, and that a public campaign chose a new city flag in 2018.
